# Phase 7A WP-B: Scale/order/tail decomposition

# Work Package B: Scale, order and tail decomposition
We ask whether a simple monotonic calibration can restore candidate consistency.

## Scale shift
- Median cross-source ratio and median log-ratio quantify multiplicative amplitude offset.
- Log Bland-Altman summary = mean/median of log(MP / JARVIS).
## Order shift
- Kendall tau on raw scores vs. source-wise quantile-normalized scores.
## Tail shift
- Top-10% threshold crossings = symmetric difference size between source top-10% sets.

## Interpretation
- If quantile normalization does not substantially raise tau, the disagreement is not a simple scale shift.
- Large threshold-crossing counts indicate the elite tail is unstable even after order-only calibration.
